approach: Static recompilation of the retail XBE to C++; XDK HLE with a Direct3D 12 renderer and XAudio2 on Windows, and a native Vulkan renderer with SDL3 on Linux (no Wine)
help: Bootstrapping XDK 5558 signatures: this XBE was built with XDK 5558, but the SDK only ships sdk/xdk/5849
Naming the unmatched XDK functions in config/game.toml once xbe_symbols can run against 5558 signatures
Kernel import coverage for the 160 kernel thunk imports (tools/kernel_coverage.py)
Bringing the native Linux Vulkan and SDL3 backends up alongside the Windows Direct3D 12 and XAudio2 ones
notes: In bring-up: the port has not booted yet. The retail USA XBE has been extracted and identified (title id 0x45410043, built 2003-11-13 with XDK 5558), and the repository, Windows and native Linux build scaffolding are in place. No gameplay, rendering, audio or save behaviour has been demonstrated yet; the immediate blocker is that the SDK ships XDK 5849 signatures while this game was built with XDK 5558.
